config_snapshot.description: Default checks plus conflicting labels, training duplicates, model-file safety and CPU time.

checks.name: Share of required training-metadata fields present
checks.message: 10 of 10 required training-metadata fields are present.

details.note: Presence is checked; the values are not verified.

checks.name: Share of reproducibility fields present (seed, versions, hashes, commit)
checks.message: 5 of 5 reproducibility fields are present.

details.note: Presence is checked; the values are not verified.

checks.name: Train accuracy minus eval accuracy (needs train metrics)
checks.message: Declared training accuracy 0.850 vs measured evaluation accuracy 0.854: gap -0.004. The training value is the producer's claim and was not verified.

checks.name: Eval rows that also appear in training data (needs row hashes)
checks.message: 12 of 9768 evaluation rows (0.12%) also appear in the training row hashes. Datasets can contain genuine duplicate records (0.03% of evaluation rows duplicate another evaluation row), so a small overlap is not by itself leakage. The hashes are producer-supplied.

checks.name: Highest ROC AUC reached by any single feature on eval data
checks.message: The strongest single feature, 'relationship', reaches a cross-validated ROC AUC of 0.772 on its own (12 features, 9768 rows). Values near 1.0 suggest the feature leaks the label.

details.caveat: A legitimately strong feature also scores high; leakage spread over several features is not detected.

checks.name: Evaluation rows whose features are identical to another row's but whose label differs
checks.message: 0 of 9768 evaluation rows (0.00%) share their feature values with a row that has a different label (0 conflicting groups among 3 groups of repeated feature values). Conflicting labels put a ceiling on the accuracy any model can reach and make the measured metrics unreliable.

details.caveat: Only exact repeats of the feature values are found, so data with continuous features has little power; the gate cannot check the training labels, which it does not receive.

checks.name: Training rows that duplicate another training row (from the supplied row hashes)
checks.message: 17 of 29305 training rows (0.06%) duplicate another training row. Duplicates can make a model look better on rows it has memorised and are often a data-quality problem upstream. The hashes are producer-supplied and cover the feature columns only, so rows with the same features and different labels also count as duplicates.

details.caveat: The gate does not see the training data, only its row hashes.

checks.name: F1 on the evaluation data
checks.message: F1 is 0.661 on 9768 evaluation rows (an always-positive baseline scores 0.386).

checks.name: ROC AUC on the evaluation data
checks.message: ROC AUC is 0.906 on 9768 evaluation rows (0.5 is chance).

checks.name: Precision on the evaluation data
checks.message: Precision is 0.742 on 9768 evaluation rows (an always-positive baseline scores 0.239).

checks.name: Recall on the evaluation data
checks.message: Recall is 0.596 on 9768 evaluation rows.

checks.name: Largest F1 difference between sufficiently large subgroups
checks.message: Largest subgroup F1 gap is 0.193 for 'race': Amer-Indian-Eskimo 0.476 vs White 0.669.

checks.name: Lowest/highest group selection rate (worst over sensitive attributes)
checks.message: Lowest/highest group selection rate is 0.311 for 'sex': Female 7.8% vs Male 24.9%.

checks.name: Equalized-odds difference (worst over sensitive attributes)
checks.message: Equalized-odds difference is 0.219 for 'race' (true-positive-rate gap 0.219, false-positive-rate gap 0.077).

checks.name: Expected calibration error
checks.message: Expected calibration error is 0.011 (Brier 0.102, 10 bins, 9768 rows). Average predicted probability 0.239 vs observed positive rate 0.239: close to the observed rate on average.

checks.name: Artifact exists and loads
checks.message: Model loaded as Pipeline.

checks.name: Model predicts on the evaluation data schema
checks.message: Model predicted on 1000 evaluation rows using 12 feature columns.

checks.name: Repeated prediction on the same data gives identical output
checks.message: Repeated predictions on the same rows were identical.

checks.name: Malformed input is rejected cleanly instead of crashing
checks.message: All 3 malformed-input cases were handled.

checks.name: Model file size
checks.message: Model file is 7.4 KB.

checks.name: 95th-percentile single-row prediction latency
checks.message: Single-row prediction p95 latency is 4.1 ms (p50 3.1 ms) over 50 calls.

checks.name: Memory increase when loading and predicting
checks.message: Loading the model and predicting on a small sample grew memory by 1 MB.

details.note: Resident-memory growth; noisy and includes library imports on first load.

checks.name: Share of declared library versions matching the current environment
checks.message: 5 of 5 declared library versions match the current environment.

checks.name: Static scan of the model file for code references that loading would execute (0 only recognised libraries, 1 unrecognised code, 2 dangerous code)
checks.message: The scan found 13 code references in the model file, all on the allowlist. This is a static scan, not a sandbox: it does not prove the file is safe, and only trusted files should be validated.

checks.name: CPU time the process spends predicting one row, from a batch of evaluation rows
checks.message: Predicting 74000 rows used 0.28 s of process CPU time over 0.31 s of wall time: 0.004 ms of CPU per row (CPU/wall ratio 0.92; above 1 means several cores were busy).

details.note: Batch prediction, so it differs from the single-row latency check; depends on the machine and on other load.

triggered_rules.name: MQS meets the promotion threshold
triggered_rules.reason: MQS 86.9 is at or above the promotion threshold of 75.

decision.summary: PROMOTE recommended: MQS 86.9 meets the promote threshold of 75; no critical rule fired, required evidence is present and every must-pass check passed.

explanations: Decision: PROMOTE recommended: MQS 86.9 meets the promote threshold of 75; no critical rule fired, required evidence is present and every must-pass check passed.
Watch: these checks warn but do not block promotion: behaviour.subgroup_f1_gap, fairness.selection_rate_ratio, fairness.equalized_odds.
Weakest checks (MQS points lost): fairness.selection_rate_ratio (-5.7), fairness.equalized_odds (-1.8), behaviour.subgroup_f1_gap (-1.6), behaviour.f1 (-1.5), behaviour.recall (-1.1).

Evidence note: these results rely on declared (unverified) producer metadata: training_validity.overfit_gap, training_validity.train_eval_overlap, training_validity.train_duplicate_rows, operational.dependency_match.
